prerequisite_addressed.what: test-architect's critical_infrastructure_gap: zero frontend test infrastructure existed prior to this stage.
config_added: vite.config.js — test: { environment: 'jsdom', globals: true, setupFiles: './src/test/setup.js', include: ['src/**/*.test.{js,jsx}'] }
prerequisite_addressed.why_include_scoping_was_needed: Without an explicit `include` glob, vitest also picked up ~40 vendored external skill/agent sources under .claude/ that ship their own unrelated *.test.* files (Node's node:test runner, differing suite shapes) and failed to bundle them. Scoping to src/**/*.test.{js,jsx} isolates this app's own suite, per CLAUDE.md §1 Minimal Impact — no vendored content was touched.

integration_scope_covered: AppShell — initial view from valid hash, fallback on invalid/missing hash, no-initialHash fallback, Sidebar selection switching TopBar/content, skip-link presence and target
Sidebar — item rendering, aria-current on active item, onSelect on click, keyboard (Tab+Enter) activation
TopBar — renders title heading, mounts UserBadge with no user prop (locks in AC-5)
UserBadge — renders name/role/initials from useCurrentUser(), aria-hidden avatar
App.jsx — app-shell hash renders AppShell alone with marketing chrome absent (locks in AC-1); non-app-shell and unrecognized hashes render the marketing tree with AppShell absent

MasterDataTable — loading (role=status/aria-live=polite), error (role=alert with message), success (headers+rows), empty-state message, useMasterDataTable mocked at the hook boundary per the plan's mock_strategy

mock_strategy_followed.network: MasterDataTable.test.jsx mocks useMasterDataTable directly via vi.mock, not fetch/MSW, per the plan.
mock_strategy_followed.appshell_and_app_tests: AppShell.test.jsx and App.test.jsx stub global fetch (not the hook) because they render through MasterDataView's real component tree rather than isolating MasterDataTable directly — this keeps them deterministic/offline without touching the hook-mocking approach reserved for MasterDataTable's own test.
mock_strategy_followed.current_user: Exercised for real everywhere (synchronous, no flakiness risk), per the plan.
mock_strategy_followed.routing: App.test.jsx sets window.location.hash directly and exercises useLocationHash for real, per the plan.
mock_strategy_followed.no_snapshot_tests: None written — every assertion queries by role/label/text (frontend.md).

verification.npx_oxlint_src: only the one pre-existing, unrelated set-state-in-effect warning in untouched src/hooks/useMasterDataTable.js

notes_for_stage_6_1_test_quality_analyze: MasterDataTable's route/columns props are covered structurally (headers/rows/empty/loading/error) rather than exhaustively per-table, matching in_scope_files_for_coverage's file-level (not per-route) scope from test-architect's plan. useMasterDataTable's own fetch/cancellation internals remain out of scope per the plan's explicitly_out_of_scope_for_this_feature (pre-existing, untouched by this feature).
